description: This file defines the ClaimRequestDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to decorate or enhance the ClaimRequest entity with additional functionalities like setting user, employee, currency, and calculating total expenses. It acts as a decorator and utility class for handling claim requests within the HRM system.

classes.name: ClaimRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ClaimRequest entity that provides methods to enrich and manipulate claim request data, including setting user, employee, currency, and calculating total expenses, as well as formatting dates.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance from the container.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Returns the current ClaimRequest object being decorated.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user for the claim request using a user ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency type of the claim request based on a currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves a CurrencyType entity based on a currency ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the claim request using an employee number.

methods.name: getTotalExpense
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves the total expense for the claim request.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the submitted date of the claim request formatted as Y-m-d string, or null if not set.
